note: Curated deep-link templates. Best-effort; app owners may change these without notice. Every entry here has been verified on a real device — see the SKILL.md `Deep Links` section for how the agent should use them. Verify against the target device with `msk app schemes <package>` and observe the landing screen after invocation.

entries.name: search
entries.description: Search videos by keyword

entries.name: video
entries.description: Open a video by its BV id (e.g. BV1xx411c7mu)

entries.name: article
entries.description: Open a column article by its numeric cv id

entries.name: user_space
entries.description: Open a user's profile by numeric mid

entries.name: user_center
entries.description: Open the current user's profile hub. Routes to MainActivityV2 with the profile tab active.

entries.name: following_feed
entries.description: Open the feed of accounts you follow. Routes to MainActivityV2.

entries.name: live_room
entries.description: Open a live-streaming room by numeric room id

entries.name: search
entries.description: Search Taobao by keyword

entries.name: item
entries.description: Open a product listing by numeric item id. May land on the login screen if the account is signed out.

entries.name: scan_qr
entries.description: Open the WeChat QR code scanner

entries.name: scan
entries.description: Open the Alipay scanner. First launch may trigger a camera permission prompt from the system, which shows up as a hijacked landing.

entries.name: search_poi
entries.description: Search points of interest. `source` is a free-form app label (e.g. `mobile-skill`).

entries.name: view_map
entries.description: Center the map on lat/lon. `dev=0` for WGS-84 coordinates, `dev=1` for GCJ-02 (Amap's mars-coordinates).

entries.name: route
entries.description: Route from start (slat, slon) to destination (dlat, dlon). `t=0` = driving.

entries.name: search
entries.description: Search across all Weibo content

entries.name: search
entries.description: Search Zhihu. `type` is one of content | question | user | topic | column.

entries.description: Open the home feed

entries.name: question

entries.name: user
entries.description: Open a user's profile by their hash id (the suffix in their profile URL, e.g. zhihu.com/people/{user_hash})
